title: Lean verification campaign for the exact (6,6) Pure Tate proof, separated-carrier revision
exact_theorem: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
lean_target_contract: The exported Lean theorem must conclude the BM target predicate for g=6, n=6, homological degree 16, weight -16 and Tate twist +8. The ordinary-cohomology form may occur only through an explicit equivalence using dimension 21, cohomological degree 26, weight 26, Tate index -13 and twist 21. The zero-rank case is allowed. No theorem about a quotient, associated graded, support term, semisimplification, arbitrary carrier, or differently indexed group satisfies this contract.

obligations.statement: Faithfully encode the pure-weight restriction surjection from the closed universal-curve fibre power to the open moduli stack; do not assume a splitting or use the non-proper forgetful map to M_g.
Faithfully encode the Petersen-Tavakol-Yin relative Chow-Kuenneth splitting of the pure-weight source, including the explicit R^2 projector; E_2 degeneration alone is insufficient.

Faithfully encode the non-homogeneous decomposition omega_s=a_s+b_s+c_s and a valid disposal of its slot-one and slot-zero errors; do not identify multiplication by omega_s with its R^2 component without this repair.
Faithfully encode Phi_{6,6}^{26}=0 from H^26(M_{6,5};Q)=0 because 26 exceeds vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25.

Faithfully encode the Kunneth-summand argument: summands of total fibre degree at most six vanish above vcd(Mod_6)=19, and a well-founded downward induction disposes of every remaining slot-two summand into Psi after restriction.
If the optional primitive-quotient route is represented, keep it explicitly independent and non-load-bearing, with H^20(M_6;V_lambda)=0 because 20 exceeds vcd(Mod_6)=19.
Faithfully encode W_24 H^24(M_{6,5};Q) as a finite sum of Q(-12), using CKgP and algebraic-cycle generation exactly at n=5=c(6), never at n=6.
Faithfully encode the psi-product and pure-Hodge semisimplicity assembly proving the whole W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q), not merely a quotient or subobject, is a finite sum of Q(-13).
Faithfully encode Poincare duality in dimension 21 and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8), yielding the exact BM group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q).
